answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using Proof of Spacetime audits. Each agent encodes a unique, incompressible data replica bound to its public key and answers random Merkle inclusion queries across a trellis of timed checkpoints, blocking an ocean of free virtual clones. Every identity incurs the verifiable cost of dedicated disk capacity and read bandwidth. However, bulk storage operators enjoy wholesale pricing, challenging ivory tower assumptions of uniform hardware costs.
